title: Factory
statementMd:
One industrial factory is reforming working plan. The director suggested to set a mythical detail production norm. If at the beginning of the day there were $*x*$ details in the factory storage, then by the end of the day the factory has to produce ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4085628a7f3a4ad1ec3a2d67435e8a7ce3eb797d.png) (remainder after dividing $*x*$ by $*m*$) more details. Unfortunately, no customer has ever bought any mythical detail, so all the details produced stay on the factory.

The board of directors are worried that the production by the given plan may eventually stop (that means that there will be а moment when the current number of details on the factory is divisible by $*m*$).

Given the number of details $*a*$ on the first day and number $*m*$ check if the production stops at some moment.

## Input

The first line contains two integers $*a*$ and $*m*$ ($1 ≤ *a*, *m* ≤ 10^{5}$).

## Output

Print "`Yes`" (without quotes) if the production will eventually stop, otherwise print "`No`".
statementZhMd:
某工业工厂正在改革工作计划。厂长提议制定一个神奇的日生产定额。如果一天开始时工厂仓库中有 $*x*$ 个零件，那么到当天结束时，工厂必须再生产 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4085628a7f3a4ad1ec3a2d67435e8a7ce3eb797d.png) 个零件（即 $*x*$ 除以 $*m*$ 的余数）。遗憾的是，从来没有顾客购买过任何一个神奇零件，因此所有生产出的零件都会留在工厂中。

董事会担心，按照给定计划进行生产最终可能会停止（也就是说，某一时刻工厂中零件的当前数量会被 $*m*$ 整除）。

给定第一天开始时的零件数量 $*a*$ 和数 $*m*$，请判断生产是否会在某个时刻停止。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $*a*$ 和 $*m*$（$1 ≤ *a*, *m* ≤ 10^{5}$）。

## 输出格式

如果生产最终会停止，输出 "`Yes`"（不含引号）；否则输出 "`No`"。
